sn10.12:1.2: Another spirit of place, Āḷavaka’s story (also at [snp1.10]()) is perhaps the most beloved of all the _yakkha_ conversions. Āḷavī was a town between Sāvatthī and Rājagaha.
sn10.12:9.2: Following Cone’s *Dictionary of Pali*, Pali _gharamesin_ probably stands for Sanskrit _gṛhamedhin_, an “educated householder” of mature years.
sn10.12:10.4: See BB for readings. the Chinese at SA2 325 and SA 1326 support dama or danta here.
